# Copilot repository context

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the shared repository instructions.
Use [the iteration guide](../docs/README.md) to find the active plan, discovery
conversation, and session record. Update that iteration as the work evolves;
do not infer a new iteration from a new session or implementation revision.

For making-of timeline edits, follow the shared process-stage and
`data-session-type` rules in `AGENTS.md` and the semantic colors in `DESIGN.md`:
code changes green, reviews orange, build failures red, unknown types blue.
Concurrent review tracks share one numbered stage, not sequential timestamps.
